  4. Use organizers: Utilize baskets, trays, and drawer dividers with labels.
  5. Keep things in their place: Designate spots for items and return them after use.
  6. Clean as you go: Clean while decluttering and organizing.
  7. Reduce your intake: Limit new items and evaluate purchases.
